statement: In many applications which require range queries, some of the input constraints are shared and not really independent. We give first non trivial indexes for handling such cases breaking the currently known O(N log N ) space barrier for four-sided queries in Word-RAM model. In Word-RAM model, we obtained linear space and optimal time index for answering SCRR queries. Our optimal I/O index in external memory takes O(N log log N ) words of space and answer queries optimally. We also present a linear space index for external memory. We leave it as an open problem to achieve optimal space bounds, avoiding the O(log log N ) blowup in external memory model. Also it will be interesting to see whether such results can be obtained in Cache Oblivious model.
